world-politics.title: US-Iran War Enters Day 30 as Diplomatic Off-Ramps Begin to Emerge
world-politics.summary: The US-Iran conflict marks its 30th day with over 3,000 killed. Iran remains wary of diplomacy amid reports of a planned US ground offensive, while 2,200 Marines arrive in the region with more troops to follow.

world-politics.title: G7 Agrees to Secure Strait of Hormuz but Only After Iran War Ends
world-politics.summary: G7 foreign ministers meeting in France agreed to a plan to secure the Strait of Hormuz, but only after the war in Iran concludes. Oil prices remain elevated with the critical shipping lane effectively closed.

world-politics.title: Huge Crowds Rally Under 'No Kings' Banner Against Trump in US and Abroad
world-politics.summary: Massive anti-Trump protests spread across the US and internationally under the 'No Kings' banner. France hosts a march as the movement gains momentum amid the ongoing Iran conflict and DHS shutdown.

world-politics.title: Sen. Lankford Says US Is Winning Iran War but Won't Rule Out Ground Troops
world-politics.summary: Senator James Lankford (R-OK) expressed confidence the US has triumphed or is on the path to victory in Iran, but emphasized the necessity for further measures and did not dismiss deploying ground troops.

world-politics.title: DHS Shutdown Hits Day 44 as Congress Leaves for Two-Week Recess
world-politics.summary: The Department of Homeland Security shutdown — now the longest in history — reaches day 44 with over 500 TSA officers quitting. Congress departed for a two-week recess with no deal in sight.

world-politics.title: Qatar and Ukraine Sign Defense Agreement as Zelenskyy Tours Gulf
world-politics.summary: Qatar and Ukraine signed a defense cooperation agreement during President Zelenskyy's Gulf tour, shaping new strategic partnerships in the region as the war with Russia continues.

us-politics.title: 'No Kings' Protests Draw Over 8 Million Nationwide in Largest Single-Day Demonstration in US History
us-politics.summary: More than 8 million people turned out across all 50 states for 'No Kings' rallies opposing the Trump administration, with Bruce Springsteen headlining in Minneapolis. The protests, the third in the series, come as Democrats aim to leverage opposition to the Iran war ahead of midterms.

us-politics.title: DHS Shutdown Hits Day 44 as Congress Leaves for Two-Week Recess Without a Deal
us-politics.summary: The DHS funding standoff drags on as the Senate passed a partial funding bill that House Speaker Johnson rejected for excluding ICE and Border Patrol. With Congress now on spring recess, the shutdown could become the longest in US history.

us-politics.title: Trump Orders TSA Workers Paid Through Executive Action as Airport Lines Hit 4+ Hours
us-politics.summary: President Trump signed an executive order directing DHS to use existing funds to pay the 61,000 TSA employees who have gone without full paychecks since February 14. Over 500 officers have resigned and airport security wait times have ballooned to 4 hours at some hubs.

us-politics.title: House Republicans Pass Fourth DHS Funding Bill — But Senate Says Dead on Arrival
us-politics.summary: The House passed its own 60-day full DHS funding bill after rejecting the Senate's version, but Senate Minority Leader Schumer declared it dead on arrival. Both chambers left Washington with no clear path to reopening the department.

us-politics.title: Bipartisan Senators Introduce Bill to Ban Prediction Market Trading by Officials
us-politics.summary: Senators Slotkin, Young, Schiff, and Curtis unveiled the Public Integrity in Financial Markets Act to bar lawmakers, the president, and staffers from trading on insider information through prediction markets like Kalshi and Polymarket.

us-politics.title: LA Clashes Mar 'No Kings' Protests as Rocks Thrown at Federal Officers
us-politics.summary: While the vast majority of 'No Kings' protests remained peaceful, tensions erupted in Los Angeles where an unlawful assembly was declared after a small group threw rocks, bottles, and concrete at federal officers. Nine people were arrested.

dfw-politics.title: Dallas Considered as Host for Unprecedented 2026 Midterm RNC Convention
dfw-politics.summary: The Republican National Committee is exploring holding a rare midterm convention at the American Airlines Center in Dallas to boost Texas voter turnout ahead of the heated Cornyn vs. Paxton Senate runoff.

dfw-politics.title: Cornyn-Paxton Senate Runoff Heats Up Ahead of May Vote
dfw-politics.summary: The May 26 Republican runoff between incumbent Sen. John Cornyn and AG Ken Paxton is shaping up to be the most expensive Senate primary in US history, with over $110 million spent on advertising.

dfw-politics.title: Dallas Democrats Drop Lawsuit Over Primary Ballots Cast After 7 PM
dfw-politics.summary: Dallas County Democrats withdrew their lawsuit seeking to count 1,756 ballots cast after extended polling hours, saying the Texas Supreme Court is 'no longer a viable forum' for a fair ruling.

dfw-politics.title: Fort Worth Democrat Rehmet Flips Historically Red Senate District
dfw-politics.summary: Democrat Taylor Rehmet won the special runoff election for Texas Senate District 9 by 14 points, flipping a GOP-held seat since 1991. Both candidates will face off again in November.

dfw-politics.title: Texas Primary Sets Record Early Voting as Senate Race Draws National Attention
dfw-politics.summary: About 2.5 million Texans voted early in the primary, with Dallas County Democrats setting a record of nearly 188,000 early votes — the highest since Obama's 2008 primary.

dfw-politics.title: House Ethics Committee Opens Investigation into Rep. Tony Gonzalez
dfw-politics.summary: The House Ethics Committee launched an investigation into Texas Rep. Tony Gonzalez, who is accused of having an affair with a staffer, coming one day after a primary resulted in a runoff for his seat.

ai-news.title: OpenAI Winds Down Sora to Prioritize 'Spud' — Its Next Major Model
ai-news.summary: OpenAI axed its Sora video generator to free up compute for 'Spud,' a next-gen model Sam Altman says will be ready in weeks and 'can really accelerate the economy.' The move puts a $1B Disney partnership on ice.

ai-news.title: Anthropic Revenue Nearly Doubles to $20B as Enterprise Share Surges
ai-news.summary: Anthropic's annual revenue reportedly surged from $9B to nearly $20B. The share of US companies paying for Anthropic tools rose from 4% to 40%, while OpenAI's enterprise spending share dropped from 50% to 27%.

ai-news.title: Morgan Stanley Warns a Massive AI Breakthrough Is Coming in 2026
ai-news.summary: Morgan Stanley says most of the world isn't ready for a transformative AI leap driven by unprecedented compute accumulation. OpenAI's GPT-5.4 scored 83% on the GDPVal benchmark — at or above human expert level.

ai-news.title: China Is Building Robot Training Farms for Humanoid AI
ai-news.summary: China is building state-funded facilities where young graduates train humanoid robots in eight-hour shifts. A Wuhan facility produces 100 hours of usable training data per day for tasks like serving food and folding laundry.

ai-news.title: Yann LeCun's AMI Labs Raises $1.03 Billion to Build World Models
ai-news.summary: Advanced Machine Intelligence (AMI Labs), led by Yann LeCun, completed a $1.03B seed round — one of the largest ever and likely the biggest for a European company — to build world models for AI.

ai-news.title: Jack Dorsey Cuts 40% of Block's Workforce, Citing AI Transformation
ai-news.summary: Block CEO Jack Dorsey cut over 4,000 jobs — 40% of staff — saying AI 'fundamentally changes what it means to build a company.' The stock surged 24%. Gross profit per employee expected to hit $2M in 2026.

jpmorgan-chase.title: JPMorgan Chase Slashes 2026 S&P 500 Target Amid Oil Supply Shock
jpmorgan-chase.summary: JPMorgan's strategists cut the bank's 2026 year-end S&P 500 target from 7,500 to 7,200, citing the oil supply shock from the Iran conflict and growing geopolitical uncertainty in global markets.

jpmorgan-chase.title: JPMorgan Chase Declares Common Stock Dividend
jpmorgan-chase.summary: JPMorgan Chase announced its latest common stock dividend and confirmed plans to host the first-quarter 2026 earnings call, as the bank navigates turbulent markets from the Iran conflict.

jpmorgan-chase.title: JPMorgan Forecasts Jump in First-Quarter Deal Fees, Trading Revenue
jpmorgan-chase.summary: JPMorgan expects mid-to-high teens growth in investment banking fees and market revenues for Q1, easing concerns about deal activity. The bank will allocate $19.8B for technology in 2026, up 10%.

jpmorgan-chase.title: JPMorgan Q1 2026 Earnings Preview: Analysts Expect $5.42 EPS
jpmorgan-chase.summary: Ahead of the Q1 earnings call, analysts forecast JPMorgan to report $5.42 per share — up 6.9% year-over-year. Full-year EPS is expected at $21.73, a 6.8% increase from fiscal 2025.

jpmorgan-chase.title: Jamie Dimon Confirms He Will Serve as CEO for Several More Years
jpmorgan-chase.summary: At the bank's investor day, CEO Jamie Dimon confirmed he plans to remain at JPMorgan Chase for several more years, putting succession speculation to rest while the bank invests heavily in AI.

jpmorgan-chase.title: JPMorgan's 2026 Outlook: AI, Fragmentation, and Inflation Shape Markets
jpmorgan-chase.summary: JPMorgan Private Bank's 2026 outlook highlights a new era shaped by AI transformation, geopolitical fragmentation, and persistent inflation as key forces influencing global investment strategy.

dfw-events.title: Cirque du Soleil: ECHO Coming to Lone Star Park
dfw-events.summary: Cirque du Soleil returns to North Texas under the Big Top at Lone Star Park with ECHO — a story about a young woman exploring the bond between humans and the animal kingdom, featuring jaw-dropping acrobatics.

dfw-events.title: Main Street Fort Worth Arts Festival — April 16-19
dfw-events.summary: One of Fort Worth's most anticipated annual events takes over the iconic red brick streets of downtown for four days of incredible art, live music, and great food with hundreds of artists from across the country.

dfw-events.title: Dallas Art Fair — April 16-19
dfw-events.summary: The Dallas Art Fair returns with a curated selection of modern and contemporary artworks from leading national and international galleries as part of Dallas Arts Month celebrations throughout April.

dfw-events.title: Dallas Blooms at the Dallas Arboretum — Through April 12
dfw-events.summary: The Southwest's largest outdoor floral festival continues at the Dallas Arboretum on White Rock Lake. Soak in the sun, sights, sounds, and scents of 500,000+ spring blooms through April 12.

dfw-events.title: Ubbi Dubbi Festival at Panther Island Pavilion — Fort Worth
dfw-events.summary: The Ubbi Dubbi electronic music festival returns to Panther Island Pavilion in Fort Worth for an 18+ event promising an unforgettable experience at one of DFW's most scenic outdoor venues.

dfw-events.title: Dallas Reggae Festival — April 11-12
dfw-events.summary: The annual Dallas Reggae Festival welcomes families to enjoy Caribbean-inspired food, arts, crafts, and reggae music. The festival celebrates cultural equality through music over two days.
